description: List every saved version of a project, newest-first. Returns summaries (id, name, timestamp, source, kind, version_number, cp) — not the inner project JSON. `kind` is `"bookmark"` (deliberate save, gets a v<N> label, partner-pinnable in the <morpha-video> embed) or `"auto"` (editor auto-snapshot every ~10 mutations, restore-only). `version_number` is bookmark-only and stable for the lifetime of that version — deletes leave gaps, numbers never re-shuffle. `cp` names which pages the version changed (comma-joined 8-char page-id prefixes; `"*"` = page order only; absent = unknown, treat as all pages). Use the returned `id` (or `v<version_number>` shorthand) with restore_version / rename_version / delete_version.
name: list_versions
